C2_aggregation: arithmetic mean of both cycle losses; neither cycle selected
C5: descriptive only; doubled C0-C4 compute/state allowance
C6: exact rational conjugacy of C1; compare states, actions and task events at zero tolerance
affected_scientific_runs: new P5 v1.1 benchmark only; v1 architecture benchmark was blocked
analytical_bound: min missed jobs = 2 times number of cells whose initial reserve is zero; C1 below this loss is instrument failure
joint_manipulation: No source/sham diagnostic is used as a Gamma-specific test. Historical source/sham joint_manipulation=true preserved.
prerequisites: P5_C4_DISPOSITION and controller/runner source published before benchmark
retention: Retain every bundle seed, task and source/config hash, all controller actions and complete event traces in deterministic gzip; full replay identity and per-shard SHA256. No outcome-dependent retention.
run_failure_rule: Task guardrail failure or above-physical-ceiling performance stops collection and preserves failed status; controller failures retain loss=1.
sample_size_rationale: 32 development bundles, same engineering scale as v1 tuning block; no inferential power or confirmatory claim attached
seed_rule: uint64 big endian first eight SHA256 bytes of namespace|b0_source_commit|P5|evaluation-development|bundle_index|cell/c/episode/utility/epoch/0/event/initial_reserve; random.Random(seed).randrange(2)
selection_rule: No tuning. Use cfg00, the prospectively fixed first canonical v1 configuration, for every adaptable arm. No optimization, cross-arm outcome selection, or imported P7 selection. C4 fixed analytically.
